references_experience.text: ng Assisted Electronic Monitoring of West Coast Fixed Gear Fisheries. The Northwest Fisheries Science Center seeks a vendor to establish and refine Electronic Monitoring protocols for the fixed gear fleet that provide a full accounting of all catch. This requirement seeks to develop and implement comprehensive assessment techniques for quota management and integration into stock assessments. This acquisition is 100% set aside for small business concerns. The associated NAICS code is 541511, Custom Computer Programming Services, and the small business size standard is $34 million. The Federal Information Security Modernization Act of 2014 (FISMA) requires each Federal agency to provide security protections for both “information collected or maintained by or on behalf of an agency” and for “information systems used or operated by an agency or by a contractor of an agency or other organization on behalf of an agency.” FISMA and other provisions of Federal law authorize the Director of the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) to promulgate information security standards for information security systems, including to ensure compliance with standards promulgated by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST). Executive Order 14028, “Improving the Nation’s Cybersecurity” (E.O. 14028), emphasizes the importance of securing software used by the Federal Government to perform its critical functions. Technical Background and Contractual History This is a new requirement (Describe Technical Background below) This is a follow-on requirement Technical Background: The below referenced data is necessary in order to continue our access to data on hospital systems on a timely basis as needed for Reports to Congress assigned to ASPE and required under Section 109 of the No Surprises Act. Contractual History ASPE has purchased this data annually for several consecutive years from this vendor 3. Compatibility or Performance Characteristics for Supply of Service Required Features & Benefits of the acquisition: ASPE conducts various health policy studies that require information on provider market structure, including hospital concentration. The AHA’s Annual Survey Database is the only national database

ase order would allow ASPE to update this information to the latest year available. The AHA database is the only national hospital-level dataset that is updated on an annual basis and that provides the data necessary many projects at ASPE including hospital system market structure and hospital staffing capacity. The database includes up to 1,000 data fields on the characteristics of approximately 6,500 hospitals including organizational structure, facility and service lines, inpatient and outpatient utilization, physician arrangements, staffing, corporate and purchasing affiliations, teaching status, geographic indicators, and cross-reference identifiers (e.g., Medicare Provider Number and National Provider Identifier). This operational experience demonstrated that an AI- enabled platform can improve the speed, consistency, analytical rigor, and educational value of wargame development and execution. The specific SEL network switches, Rockwell Automation components, and Datalogic scanners have been formally evaluated and approved by the DLA Cybersecurity (Cyber) Division in support of this project’s network design. Introducing alternative, unvetted hardware would invalidate the existing network security approvals and mandate a lengthy Authorization to Operate (ATO) reassessment process. Additionally, alternative hardware options present unacceptable risks of containing components manufactured in prohibited foreign nations, specifically the People's Republic of China. Utilizing hardware with Chinese-origin components violates strict DoD supply chain security directives designed to prevent cyber-espionage and hardware-level vulnerabilities. Standardizing on this approved, vetted hardware stack guarantees supply chain integrity, minimizes geopolitical risk, and ensures immediate compliance with DoD information assurance mandates.
